Basis for Intervening:
Pursuant to 18 C.F.R. § 385.214 (Rule 214), EDF power solutions, Inc. (EDF) respectfully moves to intervene in Docket No. ER27-25. In support of its motion EDF states as follows: 
EDF is wholly owned by EDF Renouvelables SA (f/k/a EDF Energies Nouvelles S.A.), which is wholly owned by Electricite de France, S.A., a French company. 
On October 2, 2026, Midcontinent Independent System Operator, Inc. (MISO) submitted a proposed revision to its Open Access Transmission, Energy, and Operating Reserve Markets Tariff to establish a Large Load Addition Resource Study (LARS) process. 
EDF develops projects in the MISO region and would therefore be directly impacted by the instant proceeding. EDF’s interests cannot be represented by any other party and this intervention is also in the public interest. EDF meets the requirements for intervention in Rule 214 and should be permitted to intervene with full party status.
EDF respectfully requests waiver of 18 C.F.R. § 385.203(b)(3) to permit more than two persons to be included on the service list for this proceeding.
